g1.label: 1. It grows in a ___
g1.why: A pouch is the pocket of skin where a baby marsupial grows.

g2.label: 2. Eat only eucalyptus ___
g2.why: Koalas eat the leaves of eucalyptus trees.

g3.label: 3. But it lays ___
g3.why: The platypus is strange because it is a mammal that lays eggs.

g4.why: Wombats leave their poo to mark (show) their area to other wombats.

g5.label: 5. It can ___ at up to 50 km an hour
g5.why: Emus can't fly, but they can run fast: up to 50 kilometres an hour.

g1.label: 1. It lays eggs
g1.why: The text says the platypus is a mammal that lays eggs.

g2.label: 2. Its baby is called a joey
g2.why: The text says a baby kangaroo is called a joey.

g3.label: 3. It eats only eucalyptus leaves
g3.why: The text says koalas eat only eucalyptus leaves.

g4.label: 4. A bird that cannot fly
g4.why: The text says the emu is a big bird that cannot fly.

g5.label: 5. Its poo is cube-shaped
g5.why: The text says wombats are famous for their cube-shaped poo.

g6.label: 6. The biggest reptile
g6.why: The text says saltwater crocodiles are the biggest reptiles in the world.

g7.label: 7. It sleeps 18 to 20 hours a day
g7.why: The text says koalas sleep 18 to 20 hours a day.

g8.label: 8. It makes swimming risky
g8.why: The text says box jellyfish make swimming in the north risky in summer.

g1.label: 1. A marsupial baby ___
g1.why: A marsupial baby is born very small and grows in its mother's pouch.

g2.label: 2. Koalas sleep so much because ___
g2.why: Koalas sleep a lot because eucalyptus leaves give them very little energy.

g3.why: Venomous animals can hurt you with poison from a bite, sting or spike.

g4.label: 4. Wombats use their poo to ___
g4.why: The text says wombats use their poo to mark their area.

g5.correct: it is a mammal that lays eggs
accept: it is a mammal that lays eggs
g5.label: 5. The platypus is strange because ___
g5.why: A platypus is a mammal, and mammals don't usually lay eggs.

g6.label: 6. Many of these animals ___
g6.why: The text says many of these animals live nowhere else in the world.

g7.label: 7. Long periods without rain
g7.why: Remember Part 1: a drought is a long period without rain.

g8.why: Remember 'Mandela': use 'which' for animals and things, 'who' for people.
